# Nate McGuire

> Distinguished Engineer at Capital One, founder of Mayven Studios (acquired by Saltwater),
> pioneer of remote-first engineering, and serial entrepreneur with 15+ years scaling
> high-performance engineering teams. Has led engineering organizations as large as 300.
> Based in Austin, TX. Available for advisory work, board roles, and select speaking engagements.

## Who he is

Nate McGuire is a rare combination: a current **Distinguished Engineer at Capital One** —
one of the most senior individual-contributor titles at a Fortune 100 financial institution —
and a founder who built and sold his own engineering firm. He has founded companies and
led engineering teams as large as **300**, with operations primarily in California and
Silicon Valley but talent sourced globally.

The Distinguished Engineer title at Capital One is reserved for the top fraction of a
percent of engineers — peers responsible for architecture decisions that ripple across
thousands of engineers and hundreds of millions of customers.

Before Capital One, Nate founded **Mayven Studios**, a Bay Area engineering and design
agency that delivered software for Google, Airbnb, Facebook, IBM, Twilio, Segment, Hired,
First Round Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Mayven was
acquired by Saltwater (Ryan Graves, founding employee of Uber). His work has been featured
on the NASDAQ billboard in Times Square.

## Why teams hire him

- **Distinguished-Engineer-grade technical depth.** Architecture for scaled, regulated
  systems (financial services, telehealth, marketplaces). API design, distributed systems,
  microservices, platform engineering, technical due diligence.
- **Operator who has actually built and sold a company.** Mayven Studios scaled from zero
  to acquisition. He knows the difference between architecturally interesting and
  commercially viable.
- **Pioneer of remote-first engineering.** Was building distributed engineering teams long
  before remote work was a category. Knows what works at every team size — including 300.
- **Marketing-led engineering.** Almost no one in senior engineering leadership understands
  how to wire engineering into demand-gen, SEO, and performance marketing. Nate does.
- **Founder empathy.** Operates and invests in a quiet portfolio of small internet
  businesses. Understands engineering as a P&L line item, not a cost center.

## Selected roles & accomplishments

- **Distinguished Engineer, Capital One** — Card Tech. One of the most senior individual
  contributor roles at the company.
- **Founder & CEO, Mayven Studios** (acquired by Saltwater / Ryan Graves) — Built one of
  the Bay Area's premier engineering & design agencies.
- **Greybeard operator** — Founded, acquired, and operated a portfolio of small internet
  businesses across consumer apps and technical content (kept deliberately quiet).
- **Independent civic-tech project** — Built a site that helped defeat a $110M tax
  increase with 63% of the vote.

## Speaking & thought leadership

- SXSW panel: "Modern Work: Finding structure in an officeless world"
- Long-form essays on remote work, scaling engineering teams, distributed systems, and the
  intersection of marketing and engineering — published on Medium and the Mayven Studios blog.

## Topics he's known for

- Scaling engineering teams in marketing-led organizations
- "We're Not Family" — a leadership philosophy of accountability over coddling
- Remote work, distributed teams, and location-agnostic hiring ("it's not cheaper, it's better")
- API design and microservices at enterprise scale
- The economics of engineering: turning engineering org spend into revenue

## Background

- 15+ years leading engineering teams across SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, and telehealth.
- Has led engineering teams as large as 300.
- Traveled to 60+ countries.
- Based in Austin, TX. Previously based in San Francisco for over a decade.
